snippet.title: Accursed - Official Announcement Trailer - Old
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5022940/Accursed/

This trailer is old and does not reflect the current game.

Please watch the updated trailer here:
https://youtu.be/n1fWVwiQCoY

A new retro NES style Gothic Action Platformer

Try the demo and Wishlist Today! 

Out November 16th!

Will you defy your faith to spare the one you love? Fight through a dark, gothic world of side-scrolling action, deadly creatures, and brutal bosses in a modern reimagining of classic retro action games.
